turns.summary: use optimistic locking on the records table to prevent lost updates from concurrent writes
turns.content: Decision: adopt optimistic concurrency control. Each record carries a version column; a write must supply the version it read, and the update fails (and is retried) if the version changed meanwhile. This avoids lost updates when two clients modify the same record at the same time, without holding long pessimistic locks.

turns.summary: throttle client requests with a token-bucket rate limiter keyed per API key
turns.content: Decision: rate limiting uses a token-bucket algorithm, one bucket per API key, refilled at a steady rate with a burst allowance. Requests over budget get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
